chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu al-'Abbas al-Baqbaq and 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would increase in his salat (prayer) during the month of Ramadan. When he had performed the night prayer, he would pray after it; the people would stand behind him, so he would go inside and leave them. Then he would come out again, and they would come and stand behind him; so he would go inside and leave them. Then he would come out again, and they would come and stand behind him; so he would go inside and leave them, repeatedly. He said: And he said: He would not pray after the night prayer in other than the month of Ramadan.

key_terms.خَلْفَهُ: behind him, indicating the people standing after him in prayer
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the time in which this increase in prayer occurred
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), referring to his devotional worship
key_terms.مِرَارًا: repeatedly, showing that this happened multiple times

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform extra salat (prayer) after the night prayer in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم increased his salat (prayer) in the month of Ramadan after the night prayer. It also describes how people tried to stand behind him, but he would withdraw from them repeatedly, and that this additional prayer after al-'atamah was specific to Ramadan.
